content: Furthermore, alternative global market revenue projections estimate the industry at USD 58.71 billion in 2026, with expectations to scale up to USD 78.9 billion by 2036 [23] . Within the domestic sphere, the South African crane market demonstrates steady, positive momentum. Projections indicate that the market scale in South Africa was valued at USD 249.5 million in 2025 and is anticipated to increase to USD 347.9 million by 2034, registering a compound annual growth rate of 3.65 percent over this period [25] . These statistics underscore a resilient market trajectory, although detailed historical data for the 2020-2024 period remains limited in international forecasts, which tend to emphasize forward-looking regional trends and all-terrain crane developments starting from 2025 [24] .
